accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 and Open-ended Question 1
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The proved-target claim is restricted to the constructed smooth signed two-fiber family; no full-class private minimax frontier is asserted.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The pair-test separation claim is accepted only UNDER the exact-uniform signed-family and sparse-occupancy construction; full-fiber aggregation remains an OEQ.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Schröder, Melnychuk, and Feuerriegel (ICLR 2025), then state precisely why its approximate-DP orthogonal learner neither supplies nor subsumes the pure-DP shared-mixture pair test.

Define the quantized core experiment, its sample law, tie convention, and randomized-response channel, and replace the OEQ's informal shell language with an explicit weighted uniform-error functional.

Turn the signed-family result into a field-level statistical frontier by constructing an explicit private estimator or a full-fiber test with a stated risk guarantee, then compare its rate sharply with a named pure-DP baseline.

recommended_next_step: Revise the three ill-posed statements and literature positioning, then advance the repaired finite signed-family pair-test angle to Stage 0.
